test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**will have**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses India's demographic situation "over the next decade," indicating a future time frame. Therefore, the verb form in the blank should reflect a future tense.
 
• "**will have**" is the future perfect tense of the verb "to have." In this context, it correctly indicates that India will possess the highest population of young people during the specified future period.
 
• Other options are grammatically incorrect or do not fit the future time frame:
 
 
• "**were having**" is the past continuous tense, indicating an action that was ongoing in the past.
 
• "**might had**" is grammatically incorrect. "Might" is a modal verb and should be followed by the base form of the verb ("have"). "Had" is the past perfect form.
 
• "**can has**" is grammatically incorrect. "Can" is a modal verb and should be followed by the base form of the verb ("have"). "Has" is the present perfect third-person singular form.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Education is fundamental for achieving full human potential, developing an equitable and 1. just __society, and promoting national development. Providing universal 2. __access to__ quality education is the key to India’s continued ascent, and leadership on the global stage in terms of economic growth, social justice and equality, scientific advancement, national integration, and cultural preservation. Universal high-quality education is the best way 3. __forward__ for developing and maximising our country's rich talents and resources for the good 4. __of __the individual, the society, the country and the world. India 5. **__will have __**the highest population of young people in the world over the next decade, and our ability to provide high-quality educational opportunities to them will determine the future of our country.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Future Perfect Tense (will have + past participle):** Used to express an action that will be completed before a specific time in the future. In this case, possessing the highest young population over the next decade.
